symptom: describe microflow printed an unbound call external action argument stored as Argument: "" (Studio Pro 11.16, an optional OData parameter left blank) as `additional = )` / `additional = ,`, which does not parse, so every mdl 1; create or modify of the microflow was refused with MDL-V1-REBUILD "the description does not parse".
cause: formatAction's CallExternalAction branch printed every mapping through describeExpr, which renders "" as nothing at all. The call microflow / call nanoflow branches had already been fixed for the same stored state with describeCallArgument (`= nothing`), and the visitor refused `nothing` outside those two calls.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_format_action.go (CallExternalAction branch -> describeCallArgument); mdl/visitor/visitor_argument_binding.go (isBlankableCallArgument now admits CallExternalActionStatementContext)
insight: Before designing a spelling for a stored state, grep how the language already spells it on a sibling: `Param = nothing` existed for exactly Argument "" on flow calls, with the same three-way distinction (blank / the value `empty` / no mapping). The issue's suggested fix - omit the mapping and have the builder re-create "" for a nullable parameter from the contract - would also round-trip, but only with the OData contract at hand, changes what omitting a parameter means, and is a second spelling of a state that already had one. `empty` (11.14) and "" (11.16) are both real stored states; the control test keeps `= empty` byte-identical. Not measured on mxbuild here: whether 11.16 accepts a "" argument on a NON-nullable parameter (a flow call gives CE0127).
